Hi Sara — thanks again for the call today. As promised, attaching the updated MAP draft (acme_map_draft_v2.pdf) with milestones and owners. I wanted to call out the Load/Performance Test milestone and propose next steps so we can lock dates: 

- Milestone: Traffic replay + load/perf validation
  - Objective: Validate 95th percentile latency under peak QPS and confirm dedicated capacity sizing
  - Proposed window: week of 2026-03-08 (flexible)
  - Redwood owner: Vivek (SE) — will run traffic replay and monitor KPIs
  - Acme owner: Daniel / Ops — provide redacted traffic profile and confirm peak QPS and replay policy
  - Dependencies: Signed contract (DocuSign), sample traffic (or synthetic profile), clearance for replay in non-prod environment
  - Target close (MAP line item): 2026-03-12 (test complete + sizing decision)

Key asks from Acme for scheduling: 
1) Confirm target peak QPS and percentile metrics you want validated (p95/p99).
2) Provide a redacted traffic profile or representative request log (see traffic_profile_jan2026.json reference in MAP).
3) Confirm preferred testing week (we suggest week of 3/8 to allow provisioning after contract).

Vivek will follow up with technical prerequisites (format, sample rate, expected sessions). If those timelines work, I will update the MAP to pin the dates and owners.

Thanks — Rishi

Hi all — quick technical note on replay and sizing: 

1) Payloads: headers + timings + request size distribution are usually sufficient for a realistic replay. If you can provide redacted full payloads we can run closer to production, but headers+timings + a sampled request-size histogram works fine. We will not need PII.

2) Format: we accept ndjson of request timestamps + path + size + optional model args. Example spec in the attached sample.

3) Lead time: 5 business days to provision a dedicated test pool once we have the signed order and sample traffic.

4) Sizing estimate (initial): based on your target 1,600 QPS burst profile and typical seq-lengths you described, we estimate an initial dedicated pool of 8 GPUs (A100-equivalent) to hit p95 < 250ms with our batching and KV-cache optimizations. We'll refine after we run a small-scale dry run.

5) Monitoring: we'll stream token-level latency and per-request traces to the MAP dashboard. Post-test we'll produce a short report with recommended commit size for Dedicated.

Next steps from technical side: 
- Acme: upload redacted traffic_profile_jan2026.json to the shared S3 link or share via secure upload by 2026-02-27.
- Redwood (Vivek): prepare repro script and a dry-run plan; provisional pool request after DocuSign (5 business days lead).

Attaching: replay_spec_example.ndjson (text)

Thanks — Vivek
